/**
 * SPICE netlist parser
 * Handles: title, components (R/C/L/V/I/D/Q/M/E/F/G/H/X), directives, comments, continuation
 */

import type { AnalysisType } from '@/shared/types';

// Value suffix mapping
const VALUE_SUFFIX: Record<string, number> = {
  // Multipliers
  t: 1e12, // tera
  g: 1e9, // giga
  meg: 1e6, // mega
  k: 1e3, // kilo
  m: 1e-3, // milli
  u: 1e-6, // micro
  n: 1e-9, // nano
  p: 1e-12, // pico
  f: 1e-15, // femto
  a: 1e-18, // atto
};

// Component types by category
const ANALOG_COMPONENTS = new Set(['R', 'C', 'L', 'V', 'I', 'D', 'Q', 'M', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H']);
const DIRECTIVE_PREFIXES = [
  '.tran',
  '.ac',
  '.dc',
  '.op',
  '.model',
  '.subckt',
  '.ends',
  '.end',
  '.save',
  '.print',
  '.probe',
];

export interface ParsedLine {
  type: 'title' | 'component' | 'directive' | 'comment' | 'continuation' | 'empty';
  text: string;
  raw: string;
  lineNumber: number;
  // For components
  refdes?: string;
  nodes?: string[];
  value?: string;
  model?: string;
  // For directives
  directiveType?: AnalysisType | 'model' | 'subckt' | 'ends' | 'end' | 'save' | 'print' | 'probe';
  directiveParams?: string;
}

export interface ParsedNetlist {
  title: string | null;
  lines: ParsedLine[];
  components: Array<{
    refdes: string;
    nodes: string[];
    value: string;
    model?: string;
    lineNumber: number;
  }>;
  directives: Array<{
    type: AnalysisType | 'model' | 'subckt' | 'ends' | 'end';
    params: string;
    lineNumber: number;
  }>;
  comments: Array<{ text: string; lineNumber: number }>;
  hasTran: boolean;
  hasAc: boolean;
  hasDc: boolean;
  hasOp: boolean;
}

/**
 * Parse a value string like "1k", "100n", "2.5e-3"
 */
export function parseValue(valueStr: string): number | null {
  if (!valueStr) return null;

  const trimmed = valueStr.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!trimmed) return null;

  // Try to match number + optional suffix
  const match = trimmed.match(/^([+-]?\d+\.?\d*(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?)\s*([a-z]*)$/);
  if (!match) return null;

  const [, numStr, suffix] = match;
  let value = parseFloat(numStr);
  if (isNaN(value)) return null;

  if (suffix in VALUE_SUFFIX) {
    value *= VALUE_SUFFIX[suffix];
  }

  return value;
}

/**
 * Detect analysis type from directive
 */
export function detectAnalysisType(lines: ParsedLine[]): AnalysisType | null {
  for (const line of lines) {
    if (line.type === 'directive' && line.directiveType) {
      if (
        line.directiveType === 'model' ||
        line.directiveType === 'subckt' ||
        line.directiveType === 'ends' ||
        line.directiveType === 'end' ||
        line.directiveType === 'save' ||
        line.directiveType === 'print' ||
        line.directiveType === 'probe'
      ) {
        continue;
      }
      if (['tran', 'ac', 'dc', 'op'].includes(line.directiveType)) {
        return line.directiveType as AnalysisType;
      }
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Check if netlist has ground node (node 0)
 */
export function hasGroundNode(parsed: ParsedNetlist): boolean {
  const nodes = new Set<string>();
  for (const comp of parsed.components) {
    for (const node of comp.nodes) {
      nodes.add(node);
    }
  }
  return nodes.has('0');
}

/**
 * Parse a SPICE netlist into structured data
 */
export function parseNetlist(text: string): ParsedNetlist {
  const lines = text.split('\n');
  const parsedLines: ParsedLine[] = [];
  const components: ParsedLine['component'][] = [];
  const directives: ParsedLine['directive'][] = [];
  const comments: ParsedLine['comment'][] = [];

  let title: string | null = null;
  let hasTran = false;
  let hasAc = false;
  let hasDc = false;
  let hasOp = false;

  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const raw = lines[i];
    const lineNum = i + 1;
    const trimmed = raw.trim();

    // Empty line
    if (!trimmed) {
      parsedLines.push({ type: 'empty', text: '', raw, lineNumber: lineNum });
      continue;
    }

    // Comment (starts with * or ;)
    if (trimmed.startsWith('*') || trimmed.startsWith(';')) {
      const commentText = trimmed.startsWith('*') ? trimmed.slice(1) : trimmed.slice(1);
      comments.push({ text: commentText, lineNumber: lineNum });
      parsedLines.push({ type: 'comment', text: commentText, raw, lineNumber: lineNum });
      continue;
    }

    // Continuation line (starts with +)
    if (trimmed.startsWith('+')) {
      parsedLines.push({ type: 'continuation', text: trimmed.slice(1), raw, lineNumber: lineNum });
      continue;
    }

    // Directive (starts with .)
    if (trimmed.startsWith('.')) {
      const rest = trimmed.slice(1);
      const parts = rest.split(/\s+/);
      const directiveName = parts[0].toLowerCase();

      let directiveType: ParsedLine['directiveType'] = directiveName as any;

      if (directiveName === 'tran') {
        hasTran = true;
      } else if (directiveName === 'ac') {
        hasAc = true;
      } else if (directiveName === 'dc') {
        hasDc = true;
      } else if (directiveName === 'op') {
        hasOp = true;
      } else if (
        ['model', 'subckt', 'ends', 'end', 'save', 'print', 'probe'].includes(directiveName)
      ) {
        // Known directive types
      } else {
        directiveType = undefined;
      }

      directives.push({
        type: directiveType as any,
        params: rest.slice(parts[0].length).trim(),
        lineNumber: lineNum,
      });

      parsedLines.push({
        type: 'directive',
        text: rest,
        raw,
        lineNumber: lineNum,
        directiveType,
        directiveParams: rest.slice(parts[0].length).trim(),
      });
      continue;
    }

    // Component line (starts with letter)
    const firstChar = trimmed.charAt(0);
    if (firstChar.match(/[a-zA-Z]/)) {
      const parts = trimmed.split(/\s+/);
      const refdes = parts[0];
      const nodes = parts.slice(1, -1); // All but first (refdes) and last (value/model)
      const value = parts.slice(-1)[0];

      // Extract model for devices that have it (D, Q, M, X)
      let model: string | undefined;
      if (['D', 'Q', 'M', 'X'].includes(firstChar.toUpperCase())) {
        // Model is typically the second-to-last or third-to-last token
        // For complex models, we need to handle quoted strings
        if (parts.length >= 3) {
          model = parts[parts.length - 2];
        }
      }

      components.push({
        refdes,
        nodes,
        value,
        model,
        lineNumber: lineNum,
      });

      parsedLines.push({
        type: 'component',
        text: trimmed,
        raw,
        lineNumber: lineNum,
        refdes,
        nodes,
        value,
        model,
      });
      continue;
    }

    // Unknown line - treat as comment
    comments.push({ text: trimmed, lineNumber: lineNum });
    parsedLines.push({ type: 'comment', text: trimmed, raw, lineNumber: lineNum });
  }

  // Extract title (first non-comment, non-empty line)
  for (const line of parsedLines) {
    if (line.type === 'component' || line.type === 'directive') {
      title = line.raw.trim();
      break;
    }
  }

  return {
    title,
    lines: parsedLines,
    components,
    directives,
    comments,
    hasTran,
    hasAc,
    hasDc,
    hasOp,
  };
}

/**
 * Validate the netlist and return warnings/errors
 */
export interface ValidationResult {
  valid: boolean;
  errors: string[];
  warnings: string[];
  parsed?: ParsedNetlist;
}

export function validateNetlist(text: string): ValidationResult {
  const result: ValidationResult = {
    valid: true,
    errors: [],
    warnings: [],
  };

  // Parse the netlist
  const parsed = parseNetlist(text);
  result.parsed = parsed;

  // Check for ground node
  if (!hasGroundNode(parsed)) {
    result.valid = false;
    result.errors.push('No ground node (node 0) found in the circuit');
  }

  // Check for analysis type
  const hasAnalysis = parsed.hasTran || parsed.hasAc || parsed.hasDc || parsed.hasOp;
  if (!hasAnalysis) {
    result.valid = false;
    result.errors.push('No analysis directive found (.tran, .ac, .dc, or .op required)');
  }

  // Check for component count
  if (parsed.components.length === 0) {
    result.valid = false;
    result.errors.push('No components found in netlist');
  }

  // Check for floating nodes (nodes that appear only once)
  const nodeConnections: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const comp of parsed.components) {
    for (const node of comp.nodes) {
      nodeConnections[node] = (nodeConnections[node] || 0) + 1;
    }
  }

  const floatingNodes = Object.entries(nodeConnections)
    .filter(([_, count]) => count === 1)
    .map(([node]) => node);

  if (floatingNodes.length > 0) {
    result.warnings.push(`Floating nodes detected: ${floatingNodes.join(', ')}`);
  }

  // Check for non-ASCII characters (will cause eecircuit-engine to hang)
  const nonAsciiMatches = [...text.matchAll(/[^\x00-\x7F]/g)];
  if (nonAsciiMatches.length > 0) {
    result.warnings.push(
      `Non-ASCII characters detected (${nonAsciiMatches.length} found). These will cause simulation to hang.`
    );
  }

  // Check for .model references
  const modelRefs = new Set<string>();
  for (const comp of parsed.components) {
    if (comp.model) {
      modelRefs.add(comp.model.toLowerCase());
    }
  }

  const definedModels = new Set<string>();
  for (const dir of parsed.directives) {
    if (dir.type === 'model') {
      const parts = dir.params.split(/\s+/);
      if (parts.length > 0) {
        definedModels.add(parts[0].toLowerCase());
      }
    }
  }

  const undefinedModels = [...modelRefs].filter((m) => !definedModels.has(m));
  if (undefinedModels.length > 0) {
    result.warnings.push(`Undefined model(s): ${undefinedModels.join(', ')}`);
  }

  return result;
}

        line.directiveType === 'ends' ||
        line.directiveType === 'end' ||
        line.directiveType === 'save' ||
        line.directiveType === 'print' ||
        line.directiveType === 'probe'
      ) {
        continue;
      }
      if (['tran', 'ac', 'dc', 'op'].includes(line.directiveType)) {
        return line.directiveType as AnalysisType;
      }
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Check if netlist has ground node (node 0)
 */
export function hasGroundNode(parsed: ParsedNetlist): boolean {
  const nodes = new Set<string>();
  for (const comp of parsed.components) {
    for (const node of comp.nodes) {
      nodes.add(node);
    }
  }
  return nodes.has('0');
}

/**
 * Parse a SPICE netlist into structured data
 */
export function parseNetlist(text: string): ParsedNetlist {
  const lines = text.split('\n');
  const parsedLines: ParsedLine[] = [];
  const components: ParsedLine['component'][] = [];
  const directives: ParsedLine['directive'][] = [];
  const comments: ParsedLine['comment'][] = [];

  let title: string | null = null;
  let hasTran = false;
  let hasAc = false;
  let hasDc = false;
  let hasOp = false;

  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const raw = lines[i];
    const lineNum = i + 1;
    const trimmed = raw.trim();

    // Empty line
    if (!trimmed) {
      parsedLines.push({ type: 'empty', text: '', raw, lineNumber: lineNum });
      continue;
    }

    // Comment (starts with * or ;)
    if (trimmed.startsWith('*') || trimmed.startsWith(';')) {
      const commentText = trimmed.startsWith('*') ? trimmed.slice(1) : trimmed.slice(1);
      comments.push({ text: commentText, lineNumber: lineNum });
      parsedLines.push({ type: 'comment', text: commentText, raw, lineNumber: lineNum });
      continue;
    }

    // Continuation line (starts with +)
    if (trimmed.startsWith('+')) {
      parsedLines.push({ type: 'continuation', text: trimmed.slice(1), raw, lineNumber: lineNum });
      continue;
    }

    // Directive (starts with .)
    if (trimmed.startsWith('.')) {
      const rest = trimmed.slice(1);
      const parts = rest.split(/\s+/);
      const directiveName = parts[0].toLowerCase();

      let directiveType: ParsedLine['directiveType'] = directiveName as any;

      if (directiveName === 'tran') {
        hasTran = true;
      } else if (directiveName === 'ac') {
        hasAc = true;
      } else if (directiveName === 'dc') {
        hasDc = true;
      } else if (directiveName === 'op') {
        hasOp = true;
      } else if (
        ['model', 'subckt', 'ends', 'end', 'save', 'print', 'probe'].includes(directiveName)
      ) {
        // Known directive types
      } else {
        directiveType = undefined;
      }

      directives.push({
        type: directiveType as any,
        params: rest.slice(parts[0].length).trim(),
        lineNumber: lineNum,
      });

      parsedLines.push({
        type: 'directive',
        text: rest,
        raw,
        lineNumber: lineNum,
        directiveType,
        directiveParams: rest.slice(parts[0].length).trim(),
      });
      continue;
    }

    // Component line (starts with letter)
    const firstChar = trimmed.charAt(0);
    if (firstChar.match(/[a-zA-Z]/)) {
      const parts = trimmed.split(/\s+/);
      const refdes = parts[0];
      const nodes = parts.slice(1, -1); // All but first (refdes) and last (value/model)
      const value = parts.slice(-1)[0];

      // Extract model for devices that have it (D, Q, M, X)
      let model: string | undefined;
      if (['D', 'Q', 'M', 'X'].includes(firstChar.toUpperCase())) {
        // Model is typically the second-to-last or third-to-last token
        // For complex models, we need to handle quoted strings
        if (parts.length >= 3) {
          model = parts[parts.length - 2];
        }
      }

      components.push({
        refdes,
        nodes,
        value,
        model,
        lineNumber: lineNum,
      });

      parsedLines.push({
        type: 'component',
        text: trimmed,
        raw,
        lineNumber: lineNum,
        refdes,
        nodes,
        value,
        model,
      });
      continue;
    }

    // Unknown line - treat as comment
    comments.push({ text: trimmed, lineNumber: lineNum });
    parsedLines.push({ type: 'comment', text: trimmed, raw, lineNumber: lineNum });
  }

  // Extract title (first non-comment, non-empty line)
  for (const line of parsedLines) {
    if (line.type === 'component' || line.type === 'directive') {
      title = line.raw.trim();
      break;
    }
  }

  return {
    title,
    lines: parsedLines,
    components,
    directives,
    comments,
    hasTran,
    hasAc,
    hasDc,
    hasOp,
  };
}

/**
 * Validate the netlist and return warnings/errors
 */
export interface ValidationResult {
  valid: boolean;
  errors: string[];
  warnings: string[];
  parsed?: ParsedNetlist;
}

export function validateNetlist(text: string): ValidationResult {
  const result: ValidationResult = {
    valid: true,
    errors: [],
    warnings: [],
  };

  // Parse the netlist
  const parsed = parseNetlist(text);
  result.parsed = parsed;

  // Check for ground node
  if (!hasGroundNode(parsed)) {
    result.valid = false;
    result.errors.push('No ground node (node 0) found in the circuit');
  }

  // Check for analysis type
  const hasAnalysis = parsed.hasTran || parsed.hasAc || parsed.hasDc || parsed.hasOp;
  if (!hasAnalysis) {
    result.valid = false;
    result.errors.push('No analysis directive found (.tran, .ac, .dc, or .op required)');
  }

  // Check for component count
  if (parsed.components.length === 0) {
    result.valid = false;
    result.errors.push('No components found in netlist');
  }

  // Check for floating nodes (nodes that appear only once)
  const nodeConnections: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const comp of parsed.components) {
    for (const node of comp.nodes) {
      nodeConnections[node] = (nodeConnections[node] || 0) + 1;
    }
  }

  const floatingNodes = Object.entries(nodeConnections)
    .filter(([_, count]) => count === 1)
    .map(([node]) => node);

  if (floatingNodes.length > 0) {
    result.warnings.push(`Floating nodes detected: ${floatingNodes.join(', ')}`);
  }

  // Check for non-ASCII characters (will cause eecircuit-engine to hang)
  const nonAsciiMatches = [...text.matchAll(/[^\x00-\x7F]/g)];
  if (nonAsciiMatches.length > 0) {
    result.warnings.push(
      `Non-ASCII characters detected (${nonAsciiMatches.length} found). These will cause simulation to hang.`
    );
  }

  // Check for .model references
  const modelRefs = new Set<string>();
  for (const comp of parsed.components) {
    if (comp.model) {
      modelRefs.add(comp.model.toLowerCase());
    }
  }

  const definedModels = new Set<string>();
  for (const dir of parsed.directives) {
    if (dir.type === 'model') {
      const parts = dir.params.split(/\s+/);
      if (parts.length > 0) {
        definedModels.add(parts[0].toLowerCase());
      }
    }
  }

  const undefinedModels = [...modelRefs].filter((m) => !definedModels.has(m));
  if (undefinedModels.length > 0) {
    result.warnings.push(`Undefined model(s): ${undefinedModels.join(', ')}`);
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Web Worker for SPICE simulation
 * Singleton Simulation instance with lazy WASM import
 */

import { Simulation } from 'eecircuit-engine';

let sim: Simulation | null = null;
let isWasmLoaded = false;

/**
 * Sanitize netlist: replace common symbols and strip non-ASCII
 */
function sanitizeNetlist(netlist: string): { sanitized: string; warnings: string[] } {
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  let sanitized = netlist;
  
  // Replace common symbols
  const replacements: [RegExp, string][] = [
    [/µ/g, 'u'],      // micro → u
    [/Ω/g, ''],       // ohm → nothing
    [/τ/g, 'tau'],    // tau → tau
    [/×/g, '*'],      // × → *
    [/−/g, '-'],      // minus → -
    [/×/g, '*'],      // multiply → *
  ];
  
  for (const [regex, replacement] of replacements) {
    if (regex.test(sanitized)) {
      sanitized = sanitized.replace(regex, replacement);
      warnings.push(`Replaced character: ${regex.source}`);
    }
  }
  
  // Strip remaining non-ASCII
  const nonAsciiMatches = [...sanitized.matchAll(/[^\x00-\x7F]/g)];
  if (nonAsciiMatches.length > 0) {
    sanitized = sanitized.replace(/[^\x00-\x7F]/g, '');
    warnings.push(`Stripped ${nonAsciiMatches.length} non-ASCII characters`);
  }
  
  return { sanitized, warnings };
}

/**
 * Lazy-load eecircuit-engine and create Simulation instance
 */
async function initSimulation(): Promise<Simulation> {
  if (sim) {
    return sim;
  }
  
  // Lazy import (handled by Vite's dynamic import)
  const { Simulation: SimClass } = await import('eecircuit-engine');
  sim = new SimClass();
  
  // Start the simulation engine
  await sim.start();
  isWasmLoaded = true;
  
  return sim;
}

/**
 * Handle a simulation request
 */
async function handleSimulate(request: {
  id: string;
  netlist: string;
  timeoutMs?: number;
}): Promise<{
  id: string;
  success: boolean;
  result?: {
    header: string;
    numVariables: number;
    variableNames: string[];
    numPoints: number;
    dataType: 'real' | 'complex';
    data: Array<{
      name: string;
      type: string;
      values: number[] | Array<{ real: number; img: number }>;
    }>;
  };
  errors?: string[];
  info?: string;
  message?: string;
}> {
  const { id, netlist, timeoutMs = 20000 } = request;
  
  try {
    // Sanitize netlist
    const { sanitized, warnings } = sanitizeNetlist(netlist);
    if (warnings.length > 0) {
      console.warn(`Netlist sanitization warnings:`, warnings);
    }
    
    const startTime = Date.now();
    
    // Initialize simulation
    postMessage({
      type: 'progress',
      id,
      state: 'loading',
      message: 'Loading WASM...',
    });
    
    const simInstance = await initSimulation();
    
    // Set the netlist
    simInstance.setNetList(sanitized);
    
    // Check for parse errors
    const parseErrors = simInstance.getError();
    const parseInfo = simInstance.getInfo();
    
    if (parseErrors.length > 0 || !simInstance.isInitialized()) {
      return {
        id,
        success: false,
        errors: parseErrors,
        info: parseInfo,
        message: 'Parse error',
      };
    }
    
    // Run simulation with timeout
    postMessage({
      type: 'progress',
      id,
      state: 'running',
      message: 'Running simulation...',
    });
    
    let timeoutId: number | undefined;
    let terminated = false;
    
    const timeoutPromise = new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
      timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
        terminated = true;
        reject(new Error('Simulation timeout'));
      }, timeoutMs);
    });
    
    const simPromise = (async () => {
      try {
        const result = await simInstance.runSim();
        return { success: true, result };
      } catch (err) {
        return { success: false, error: err };
      }
    })();
    
    let simResult: { success: boolean; result?: any; error?: any };
    
    try {
      simResult = await Promise.race([
        simPromise,
        timeoutPromise,
      ]);
    } finally {
      if (timeoutId) {
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      }
    }
    
    if (terminated) {
      // Restart the worker by recreating the simulation
      sim = null;
      isWasmLoaded = false;
      
      return {
        id,
        success: false,
        message: 'The spirits went silent (timeout)',
        errors: ['Simulation timed out after ${Math.round(timeoutMs / 1000)}s'],
      };
    }
    
    if (!simResult.success) {
      const errors = simInstance.getError();
      const info = simInstance.getInfo();
      
      return {
        id,
        success: false,
        errors,
        info,
        message: 'Simulation error',
      };
    }
    
    const result = simResult.result;
    
    return {
      id,
      success: true,
      result: {
        header: result.header,
        numVariables: result.numVariables,
        variableNames: result.variableNames,
        numPoints: result.numPoints,
        dataType: result.dataType,
        data: result.data,
      },
    };
    
  } catch (err: any) {
    return {
      id,
      success: false,
      message: err.message || 'Unknown error',
      errors: [err.message || 'Unknown error'],
    };
  }
}

// Message handler
self.onmessage = async (event: MessageEvent) => {
  const message = event.data;
  
  if (message.type === 'simulate') {
    const response = await handleSimulate(message);
    postMessage({
      type: 'response',
      id: message.id,
      ...response,
    });
  }
};

self.onerror = (err) => {
  console.error('Worker error:', err);
};

    variableNames: string[];
    numPoints: number;
    dataType: 'real' | 'complex';
    data: Array<{
      name: string;
      type: string;
      values: number[] | Array<{ real: number; img: number }>;
    }>;
  };
  errors?: string[];
  info?: string;
  message?: string;
}> {
  const { id, netlist, timeoutMs = 20000 } = request;
  
  try {
    // Sanitize netlist
    const { sanitized, warnings } = sanitizeNetlist(netlist);
    if (warnings.length > 0) {
      console.warn(`Netlist sanitization warnings:`, warnings);
    }
    
    const startTime = Date.now();
    
    // Initialize simulation
    postMessage({
      type: 'progress',
      id,
      state: 'loading',
      message: 'Loading WASM...',
    });
    
    const simInstance = await initSimulation();
    
    // Set the netlist
    simInstance.setNetList(sanitized);
    
    // Check for parse errors
    const parseErrors = simInstance.getError();
    const parseInfo = simInstance.getInfo();
    
    if (parseErrors.length > 0 || !simInstance.isInitialized()) {
      return {
        id,
        success: false,
        errors: parseErrors,
        info: parseInfo,
        message: 'Parse error',
      };
    }
    
    // Run simulation with timeout
    postMessage({
      type: 'progress',
      id,
      state: 'running',
      message: 'Running simulation...',
    });
    
    let timeoutId: number | undefined;
    let terminated = false;
    
    const timeoutPromise = new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
      timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
        terminated = true;
        reject(new Error('Simulation timeout'));
      }, timeoutMs);
    });
    
    const simPromise = (async () => {
      try {
        const result = await simInstance.runSim();
        return { success: true, result };
      } catch (err) {
        return { success: false, error: err };
      }
    })();
    
    let simResult: { success: boolean; result?: any; error?: any };
    
    try {
      simResult = await Promise.race([
        simPromise,
        timeoutPromise,
      ]);
    } finally {
      if (timeoutId) {
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      }
    }
    
    if (terminated) {
      // Restart the worker by recreating the simulation
      sim = null;
      isWasmLoaded = false;
      
      return {
        id,
        success: false,
        message: 'The spirits went silent (timeout)',
        errors: ['Simulation timed out after ${Math.round(timeoutMs / 1000)}s'],
      };
    }
    
    if (!simResult.success) {
      const errors = simInstance.getError();
      const info = simInstance.getInfo();
      
      return {
        id,
        success: false,
        errors,
        info,
        message: 'Simulation error',
      };
    }
    
    const result = simResult.result;
    
    return {
      id,
      success: true,
      result: {
        header: result.header,
        numVariables: result.numVariables,
        variableNames: result.variableNames,
        numPoints: result.numPoints,
        dataType: result.dataType,
        data: result.data,
      },
    };
    
  } catch (err: any) {
    return {
      id,
      success: false,
      message: err.message || 'Unknown error',
      errors: [err.message || 'Unknown error'],
    };
  }
}

// Message handler
self.onmessage = async (event: MessageEvent) => {
  const message = event.data;
  
  if (message.type === 'simulate') {
    const response = await handleSimulate(message);
    postMessage({
      type: 'response',
      id: message.id,
      ...response,
    });
  }
};

self.onerror = (err) => {
  console.error('Worker error:', err);
};

/**
 * Core type definitions for Circuit Séance
 */

// Analysis types supported by SPICE
export type AnalysisType = 'tran' | 'ac' | 'dc' | 'op';

// Raw result from eecircuit-engine
export interface SimResult {
  header: string;
  numVariables: number;
  variableNames: string[];
  numPoints: number;
  dataType: 'real' | 'complex';
  data: Array<{
    name: string;
    type: string;
    values: number[] | [number, number][]; // real or complex pairs
  }>;
}

// Compact numeric digest passed to the LLM spirit
export interface CompactSummary {
  analysisType: AnalysisType;
  tran?: {
    channels: Array<{
      name: string;
      min: number;
      max: number;
      final: number;
      tauEstimate: number | null; // 63.2% rise time constant
      riseTime: number | null; // 10%–90%
      overshootPct: number | null;
    }>;
  };
  ac?: {
    dcGainDb: number;
    minusThreeDbFreq: number | null; // Hz
    peakGainDb: number | null;
    peakFreqHz: number | null;
  };
  dc?: {
    sweepVar: string;
    outputVar: string;
    min: number;
    max: number;
    midSlopePerUnit: number;
  };
  op?: {
    nodeVoltages: Record<string, number>; // node name → volts
  };
}

// LLM configuration and preset types
export type ProviderPreset = 'qwen-dashscope' | 'openai' | 'gemini' | 'anthropic';

export interface LLMConfig {
  provider: ProviderPreset;
  apiKey: string;
  baseUrl: string; // user-editable
  model: string; // user-editable
}

export interface ProviderPresetInfo {
  baseUrl: string;
  model: string;
  displayName: string;
}

export const PROVIDER_PRESETS: Record<ProviderPreset, ProviderPresetInfo> = {
  'qwen-dashscope': {
    baseUrl: 'https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1',
    model: 'qwen-vl-max',
    displayName: 'Qwen-VL (DashScope)',
  },
  openai: {
    baseUrl: 'https://api.openai.com/v1',
    model: 'gpt-4o',
    displayName: 'OpenAI',
  },
  gemini: {
    baseUrl: 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai',
    model: 'gemini-1.5-pro',

  },
  anthropic: {
    baseUrl: 'https://api.anthropic.com',
    model: 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022',
    displayName: 'Anthropic Claude',
  },
};

// Application settings (persisted)
export interface AppSettings {
  llm: LLMConfig | null;
  storageMode: 'session' | 'local';
  language: 'en' | 'zh-CN';
}

// Captured image data
export interface CapturedImage {
  base64: string;
  mimeType: string;
  filename?: string;
  sizeBytes: number;
}

// Demo and sample assets
export interface SampleAsset {
  id: string;
  svgPath: string;
  netlistPath?: string;
  cannedExplanation?: {
    en: string;
    'zh-CN': string;
  };
  netlistText?: string; // inline for bundled examples
}

export type DemoStep = 'idle' | 'intro-animation' | 'transcribing' | 'simulating' | 'done';

// Homework check result
export interface HomeworkCheckResult {
  field: string;
  expected: number;
  actual: number | null;
  errorPct: number | null;
  pass: boolean;
  explanation: {
    en: string;
    'zh-CN': string;
  };
